steps.title: Tell us about your space
steps.text: Share a few photos, how much light you get and how much time you have for plants.

steps.title: Get a plan
steps.text: A short video call or message with plant suggestions and a simple layout idea.

steps.title: Choose your plants
steps.text: Order healthy plants from the shop, or ask us to source what your plan needs.

steps.title: Keep them thriving
steps.text: Care notes, plus regular maintenance visits if you'd like us to look after your garden.
